title: Digify Africa Launches AI-Focused Digital Skills Programme Targeting 63% Mobile Internet Usage Gap
detail: Digify Africa publicly invited young people across the continent to enroll in a new AI-focused skills programme on May 6, 2026, covering digital foundations, artificial intelligence literacy, and cybersecurity. The announcement cited GSMA 2026 Mobile Economy data showing a 63% mobile broadband usage gap — the share of Africans with signal coverage who still do not use the internet — and UNICEF data noting 9 in 10 non-internet-using youth live in Africa, Asia, or the Pacific. The programme targets digital skills as the primary barrier to closing Africa's usage gap, emphasizing that infrastructure-only approaches have failed to translate coverage expansion into adoption in the continent's rural and low-income populations.

title: Starlink Reaches 11,979 Total Satellites Launched; 166-Country Service Map Confirmed
detail: Following a May 5, 2026 Falcon 9 launch deploying 24 additional Starlink broadband satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base, the Starlink constellation reached 11,979 total satellites launched, with 10,398 in orbit and 8,692 operational as of May 6. SpaceX's official availability map confirms active service in 166 countries worldwide, with 42 additional country launches planned for 2026 including West African nations (Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Togo, Tunisia) and Western Balkan states. The constellation continues to expand at a cadence of approximately 2 launches per week, maintaining its position as the world's largest commercial satellite constellation and primary LEO broadband provider for underserved rural communities globally.
